heading: top-left
name: 靠左標題＋底色面板內的卡片輪播（兩側箭頭）
desc: 上方靠左的標題組，下方一塊對齊內容寬度的底色面板，面板內是一排被右緣裁切的等高卡片輪播，左右兩側各一顆箭頭。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方靠左放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題組下方是一塊有底色的大面板，左右對齊頁面內容寬度，面板內是多個項目的輪播：卡片等寬、等高，一次露出三張完整卡片，第四張只露出一部分、被面板內側的右緣裁切，不超出面板，也不延伸到畫面邊緣。面板左右兩側各放一顆圓形箭頭按鈕，垂直置中，壓在面板左右緣上、和最外側卡片的邊緣重疊少許。每個項目是一張與面板底色不同的卡片：上段左右並排，左側是方形圖片、約佔卡片內寬一半，右側靠上由上而下放次要文字、一段短文字、按鈕與一排小圖示；下方一條分隔線橫跨卡片內寬，分隔線下方是標題與說明文字；次要文字、按鈕、小圖示與說明文字可省略，沒有時省略，其他元素位置不變。內容集中在卡片上半部，卡片下方留大片空白。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：標題組在上方靠左，面板仍對齊頁面內容寬度；輪播改為一次只露出一張卡片，卡片在面板內置中，不露出下一張；左右箭頭按鈕仍在面板兩側垂直置中、和卡片邊緣重疊少許；卡片內部結構不變。

en.name: Left-aligned heading + card carousel inside a tinted panel (side arrows)
en.desc: A heading group aligned left at the top, above a tinted panel aligned to the content width holding a row of equal-height cards clipped at the right, with an arrow button on each side.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a large panel with its own background color, aligned left and right to the page content width; inside the panel is a carousel of multiple items: the cards are equal width and equal height, three full cards are visible at a time and only part of the fourth shows, clipped by the panel's inner right edge; it never extends beyond the panel or to the edge of the viewport. Place a circular arrow button on each of the panel's left and right sides, vertically centered, sitting on the panel's left and right edges and overlapping the edge of the outermost card slightly. Each item is a card in a color different from the panel: the upper part is two columns side by side, with a square image on the left taking about half of the card's inner width and, on the right aligned to the top, from top to bottom: secondary text, a short line of text, a button and a row of small icons; below, a divider spans the card's inner width, and below the divider are a title and a description; the secondary text, button, small icons and description are optional; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. The content is concentrated in the upper half of the card, leaving a large empty space at the bottom of the card.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally: the heading group stays at the top, aligned left, and the panel stays aligned to the page content width; the carousel shows only one card at a time, centered in the panel, without revealing the next one; the left and right arrow buttons stay on both sides of the panel, vertically centered and overlapping the card's edges slightly; the card's inner structure is unchanged.
